facts.text: Jon has left his secure 9-5 job as a banker to pursue a career in dancing.

evidence.quote: It's made me grow, and even got me out of my secure 9-5 as a banker. Now, I'm aiming to turn my dancing passion into a business.

facts.text: Jon acknowledges the difficulties of his current endeavor, stating it is not an easy path.

evidence.quote: That being said, I definitely don't underestimate the difficulties - it ain't been a walk in the park, that's for sure.

facts.text: Gina offers support to Jon, expressing confidence that he can make his dance studio business work.

evidence.quote: It's tough starting a biz, but don't let it get you down. You can make your studio work, I'm sure.

facts.text: Jon expresses gratitude to Gina for her support and commitment to staying optimistic and persistent.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina. Your help means a lot. I'll keep plugging away and stay optimistic.
